alarms.en: What am I avoiding right now?
If someone filmed the last two hours, what would they think I want?
alarms.zh: 如果有人拍下过去两小时，会觉得我想要什么？

alarms.en: Am I moving toward the life I hate, or the life I want?
alarms.zh: 我在走向讨厌的生活，还是想要的生活？

alarms.en: What important thing am I pretending is not important?
alarms.zh: 我在假装什么重要的事不重要？

alarms.en: What did I do today to protect my identity, not from real desire?
alarms.zh: 今天哪些事是为了维护身份，而不是真心想做？

alarms.en: When did I feel most alive today? Most dead?
alarms.zh: 今天什么时候最有活力？什么时候最像“死掉”？

core_en: Change often comes in three steps: dissonance (you feel you do not belong in this life), uncertainty (you do not know what is next), discovery (you find what to pursue).
core_zh: 改变常常分三步：失调（觉得现在的生活不属于自己）、不确定（不知道接下来是什么）、发现（找到值得追求的方向）。

evening.en: Write down your one insight. Name the real enemy — not people or circumstances, but the inner pattern. Then write one sentence for your anti-vision and one for your vision. Finally, use three lenses: 1 year, 1 month, and daily.

steps.en: What must be true in one year to know the old pattern is broken?
steps.label: 1 年
steps.zh: 一年后怎样才算打破了旧模式？

steps.en: What must be true in one month to keep the one-year goal possible?
steps.label: 1 个月
steps.zh: 一个月后怎样，一年目标才还可能实现？

steps.en: What 2–3 actions would the future you simply do tomorrow?
steps.label: 每天
steps.zh: 未来的你，明天会自然去做的 2–3 件事是什么？

evening.zh: 写下你今天最大的一个洞察。给真正的敌人起个名字 —— 不是别人或环境，而是内心的那个循环模式。再各用一句话写下反愿景和愿景。最后用三个时间镜头定目标。

label: Chapter 06 · 一日重启计划 · 核心方法

anti_vision.en: Look at the pain first: the small daily annoyance you have learned to live with, the three complaints you repeat but never change, what your behaviour (not your words) says you want, and what an unchanged Tuesday looks like in 5 years, in 10 years, and at the end of a safe life.
items: 哪种每天都在、你已经习惯了的小不满？
你反复抱怨、却从不改变的三件事是什么？
如果只看你的行为（不听你说的话），别人会觉得你真正想要什么？
如果五年、十年什么都不变，一个普通的星期二会是什么样？到人生尽头回头看，你失去了什么再也拿不回来的东西？
anti_vision.title: 反愿景（Anti-vision）— 诚实回答

vision.en: Forget practicality for a moment: if you could live a different life in 3 months, what would an average Tuesday look like? What would you have to believe about yourself for that life to feel natural? Write an “I am the type of person who …” sentence. What is one thing you would do this week if you were already that person?
items: 如果打个响指，三个月后过上另一种生活，那会是什么样？同样具体到一个星期二。
要相信什么，你才会觉得那种生活很自然？写一句 “I am the type of person who …”。
如果你已经是那个人，这周会做的一件事是什么？
vision.title: 愿景（Vision）

paragraphs.en: The best changes in the author’s life came after he felt completely fed up with no progress. The tool for that moment is questioning — not copying answers from the internet, but asking questions that are worth asking.
paragraphs.zh: 作者说，他人生中最好的变化，都发生在对“毫无进展”彻底受够了之后。那一刻的工具就是提问 —— 不是从网上复制答案，而是问真正值得问的问题。

paragraphs.en: Journaling alone is not enough. Set alarms through the day. When one rings, stop and ask one question. Put them where autopilot lives: commuting, meetings, scrolling.
paragraphs.zh: 光写日记不够。白天设几个闹钟，一响就停下来问自己一个问题。把它们放在“自动驾驶”最常出现的地方：通勤、开会、刷手机时。

title_en: The one-day protocol: dig, interrupt, synthesise
title_zh: 用一天时间，挖出你真正想要的人生

vocab.def_zh: 失调；不协调感。心里觉得“这不是我的生活”。
vocab.example_en: The dissonance grew until I had to change.
vocab.example_zh: 那种不协调感越来越强，直到我不得不改变。

vocab.def_zh: 自动驾驶模式；无意识地按习惯生活。on autopilot = 靠惯性过日子。
vocab.example_en: I lived on autopilot for years.

vocab.def_zh: 挖掘；发掘。psychological excavation = 心理挖掘。
毫不留情的诚实； brutal = 残酷的、直白的。
vocab.example_zh: 用毫不留情的诚实来回答。
